title: His parents' church and Knights of Peter Claver activities
summary: His father belonged to the Knights of Peter Claver and Holy Name Society and his mother to the auxiliary.

story.theme_name: Church, faith and religion in a musician's life
story.community_name: Church, faith and jazz: the sacred and the secular

blocks.x: Looking at different celebrations, it seems like your mother and father were joined, they belonged to a lot of organizations.

Well, my father belonged to the Knights of Peter Claver, and at the time of his death, he was just going to be accepted into the fourth degree Knights. And he worked with the Holy Name Society and all that. My mother was a lady, Knights of Peter Claver, I think you'll call her, I can't think of the name, auxiliary ladies and so forth. They belonged to different things like that. Church organizations. Church organizations.
